resources.string: Allow this USB-authorized computer to run diagnostic tests on VECTOR Probe while this screen stays open. Tests may include camera capture, microphone sampling, speaker audio tone, vibration, screen & touch digitizer, sensors, battery telemetry, and temporary app-private storage I/O. Sensitive tests require your on-screen interaction or runtime permissions. Camera frames and audio samples are processed locally and are never stored or transmitted. Only derived numeric results are sent to the computer: audio level (RMS and peak), camera frame size and brightness statistics (luma mean and variance), sensor statistics, touch-grid coverage and screen size, battery and system telemetry, and your answers to on-screen questions. Storage testing writes a temporary 64 KiB file and deletes it immediately; a failed deletion is reported. Leaving this screen, locking the phone or opening a permission dialog ends the session; allow again to reconnect.
